note.en: Her signature gives her everything she needs: Anomaly Mastery as its main stat for her passive, unconditional Anomaly Proficiency and a 40% Fire DMG bonus, which she has no other source of. S5 is about 109% of S1.
About 88% of her signature. It has an Anomaly Mastery main stat for her passive and unconditional Anomaly Proficiency, which makes it the best stat stick when her signature is not available.
About 84%. Her kit has few DMG Dealt bonuses, and this Battle Pass W-Engine's bonuses are effectively always active. At S5 it is the best A-rank option, ahead of some limited engines.

About 82%. Its Anomaly Proficiency main stat is useful and the extra Anomaly buildup can add Vortexes, but that does nothing for her CRIT passive. It can fall behind [[wengine:weeping-gemini]] depending on the route.
About 82%. The craftable free-to-play option. Its high Anomaly Proficiency still works well, since Windswept and frequent Burn Vortexes let her ramp up quickly.
